response.rationale: The item is apparel (not electronics), delivered 12 days ago (<= 30), and not final sale. Per RET-007 the standard 30-day return window applies and the item is eligible. Higher-priority rules do not apply: not final sale (RET-012), not marked defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant or fraud hold. The customer's framing (wrong size / changed mind) does not affect eligibility within the standard window.
